baseline_manifest.purpose: final matched-source baseline; pilot used the same profiler before rustfmt formatting

limitations: Single host; fixed order within blocks; eight synthetic query vectors per corpus.
In-process timings exclude wire transport and serialization; not comparable to T20 PostgreSQL client timings.
Top-level scalar columns only; nested/container/unindexed columns retain scan behavior.
Resident memory includes the complete database and keyword index.
No GPU, answer-quality or concurrent-throughput claim; normal app remains on T19.
